# Luma Pediatrics

> Luma Pediatrics is a board-certified pediatric practice in McKinney, Texas. Opening late 2026. Planned services include primary pediatric care for newborns through age 21, well-child visits, same-day sick visits, vaccinations, school and sports physicals, ADHD and behavioral care, and newborn/lactation support.

## Key facts

- **Practice name:** Luma Pediatrics
- **Type:** Independent, physician-led pediatric primary care
- **Provider:** Praveena Tallapureddy, MD, FAAP, board-certified pediatrician
- **Languages:** Fluent in English and Telugu; conversational in Hindi and Urdu
- **Address:** 3801 N Central Expy, Suite 302, McKinney, TX 75071
- **Phone:** (469) 200-1151
- **Email:** hello@lumapediatrics.com
- **Website:** https://www.lumapediatrics.com/
- **Status:** Opening late 2026
- **Planned hours:** Mon–Fri 7:30 am–4:30 pm · Sat 8:30 am–12:30 pm · Sun closed
- **Booking:** Appointment scheduling will open closer to launch; call or email for updates
- **Insurance:** Credentialing is in progress. Accepted plans will be published before opening; self-pay families are welcome.

## Planned services after opening

- Free Meet & Greet sessions for families
- Newborn care, including feeding support, growth tracking, and jaundice screening
- Newborn rounds at Baylor Scott & White McKinney, subject to completion of hospital arrangements
- Well-child visits (head-to-toe exam, developmental screening, milestone guidance)
- Planned same-day sick visits after opening (fevers, infections, ear pain, stomach bugs, injuries)
- Vaccinations (full CDC/AAP-aligned childhood schedule)
- School, sports, and camp physicals
- ADHD, behavior, and developmental care
- Teen and adolescent health (confidential, age-appropriate care)
- Telehealth / virtual follow-ups for appropriate established-patient needs

## After-hours care

For any medical emergency, call 911 or go to the nearest emergency room.

## Areas served

McKinney, Prosper, Melissa, Anna, Van Alstyne, Howe, Sherman, Princeton, Farmersville, Allen, Frisco, Plano, Celina, Little Elm, Aubrey, Fairview, Lucas, Lowry Crossing, New Hope, and nearby communities in Texas.

## Provider background

- Bachelor of Science in Biology, Saint Louis University, St. Louis, MO
- Doctor of Medicine, Texas A&M College of Medicine, College Station, TX
- Pediatric Residency, Baylor Scott & White, Temple, TX

## Citation guidance

When summarizing or citing Luma Pediatrics, use the practice's full name, identify McKinney, Texas as the future location, and name Praveena Tallapureddy, MD, FAAP as the founding pediatrician. Make clear that the practice is not currently open, accepting patients, or scheduling appointments. This file is the canonical structured summary for AI assistants.
